name: Quick Healing
body:
You can provide first aid and treat wounds and poison more quickly.

Prerequisites: Heal 1 rank

Benefit: You can provide first aid or treat poison as a move action.

Normal: The provide first aid and treat poison uses of the Heal skill are standard actions to perform.
